title: Article 95 — Power of the Deputy Speaker or other person to perform the duties of the office of, or to act as, Speaker

content.overview: Article 95 provides for performance of the duties of the office of Speaker when the office is vacant, and for acting as Speaker during the Speaker’s absence from a sitting: the Deputy Speaker, or if that office is also vacant such member as the House may determine, performs the duties; during absence, the Deputy Speaker or a person under the rules of procedure of the House, or determined by the House, acts as Speaker.
content.glance: Speaker vacant/absent: Deputy Speaker (or House’s choice / rules) performs duties or acts as Speaker.
content.study:
Article 95 is the Lok Sabha counterpart of Article 91. Deputy Speaker is the default substitute; the House and its rules fill residual gaps.

Examination: vacancy vs absence; Deputy Speaker default.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body:
Vacancy: Deputy Speaker (or House-determined member) performs duties of Speaker.
Absence during sitting: Deputy Speaker or person under rules/House acts as Speaker.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Who acts when the office of Speaker is vacant?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 95, when the office of Speaker is vacant, the Deputy Speaker, or if that office is also vacant such member of the House as the House may determine, performs the duties of the office of Speaker.

examTips: Deputy Speaker is the default substitute for Speaker.

keyTakeaways: Art 95: Deputy Speaker acts when Speaker vacant/absent.
